grid.note: constant-tempo grid = robust linear fit of a DP beat tracker on the full-mix onset envelope, then shifted to the measured max-slope of clap/hat transients in the mix (librosa onset envelopes are ~25 ms late)

method: librosa 1.0.0; HPSS(margin 1,2); band onset envs on percussive (kick 30-150Hz, snare/clap 1.5-6k, hat 6-11k) and harmonic (bass 30-200, vocal-band 300-3k proxy); beat_track tightness 400 with tempo hint; checkerboard novelty (L=16 beats) + agglomerative(14) for section candidates | demucs htdemucs stems (drums/bass/vocals/other) -> band onset envelopes; stem onset times corrected by -50 ms (25 ms demucs output delay + ~25 ms onset-envelope lag). Candidates only; the chart is curated in chart.json.
